# ExpertRating

> > ExpertRating is an ISO 9001:2015 certified online certification and employee testing platform offering 1100+ professional certifications across IT, fitness, healthcare, and business skills, trusted by Google, Walmart, IKEA, and 25 million users worldwide.

ExpertRating provides both self-paced and instructor-led certification courses for individual professionals and corporate employee testing solutions. The platform is recognized as a Google SME Heroes winner and processes payments securely through Stripe.

## Key Topics

- Online Certification
- Professional Certification
- Employee Testing
- Skills Assessment
- ISO 9001:2015
- Fitness Certifications
- Healthcare Certifications
- IT Certifications
- Six Sigma (Green Belt & Black Belt)
- CPR Certification
- Personal Trainer Certification
- Professional Development
- Career Advancement
- Workforce Development
- ExpertRating Solutions

## Certification Catalog

- [Complete List of Online Tests and Certifications](https://expertrating.com/examlist.asp): Complete catalog of 1100+ certification tests including ASP.NET, C#, SQL
- [Tests and Certifications by Category](https://expertrating.com/certifications.asp): Main certification catalog organized by category (Fitness, IT, Healthcare)
- [Accounting Fundamentals Certification](https://expertrating.com/certifications/office-skills/Accounting-Fundamentals-certification.asp): Accounting Fundamentals certification course covering financial statements
- [Advanced Yoga Certification](https://expertrating.com/certifications/fitness/advanced-yoga-certification.asp): Advanced Yoga certification covering chakras, karma, dharma, and asanas
- [Agile Certification Program](https://expertrating.com/certifications/management-and-quality-improvement/Agile-Certification-Program.asp): Agile methodology certification program for project management professionals
- [Help Desk Certification](https://expertrating.com/certifications/Help-Desk-Certification.asp): Help Desk certification for technical support and customer service skills
